candidate_pool.reconstruction: same dataset and reading task; development-training-catalog negatives plus validation targets from the target trial's own checkpoint or decision partition only; closest whitespace-token length; seeded SHA256 tie-break and order
candidate_pool.hash_freeze: derive during the all-four real-data smoke from the verified exact input, then require that exact SHA256 as a full-run argument
candidate_pool.scope: frozen primary pilot pool; a later model-independent semantic or lexical hard pool remains required before journal claims

training.interpretation: isolates explicit task-conditioned parameterization beyond common task-homogeneous sampling; it does not estimate the effect of task-aware batching itself
training.capacity_interpretation: total parameter storage is matched; routed configurations activate fewer parameters per example, so a null result cannot reject task structure generally

checkpoint_decision_partition.allocation: first floor(n_texts/2) per task to checkpoint; remainder to decision

evaluation.checkpoint_metric: macro mean of ZuCo2 NR and TSR MRR on the target-text-disjoint checkpoint partition
evaluation.candidate_partition_policy: checkpoint and decision targets never appear in the opposite partition's candidate pools; the two partitions share only development-training-catalog negatives
evaluation.signal_task_matrix: all signal conditions with correct task plus correct signal with all task conditions
evaluation.masked_separate_operationalization: arithmetic mean of the three private-adapter cosine-score predictions
evaluation.seed_aggregation: mean per-trial endpoint across the three frozen seeds before model comparison

uncertainty.familywise_method: Bonferroni across the two planned baselines within each cluster
uncertainty.seed_diagnostic: report every seedwise task-macro delta and require the model-comparison direction to be positive in all three seeds

requirements: headline macro MRR greater than both planned baselines
familywise lower bound greater than zero for both comparisons under all three cluster schemes
model-comparison macro MRR delta positive in all three training seeds
correct-minus-matched-wrong headline macro MRR gap positive with clustered lower bounds above zero and not below either planned baseline
correct-task minus masked-task and shuffled-task macro MRR gaps positive with familywise clustered lower bounds above zero
